newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: AUSTRALIA OFFICIAL RESERVE ASSETS FALL IN JULY.
newsitem.headline: AUSTRALIA OFFICIAL RESERVE ASSETS FALL IN JULY.

text.p: Australia's holdings of official reserve assets, including foreign exchange and gold, fell by A$337 million to A$22.431 billion in July, reflecting revaluation effects, the Reserve Bank said on Thursday.
In U.S. dollar terms, the reserves - including special drawing rights and Australia's reserve position with the International Monetary Fund - fell by US$257 million to US$16.715 billion.
Gold holdings fell to US$1.289 billion (A$1.730 billion) in July while foreign exchange holdings fell to US$14.932 billion (A$20.038 billion).
The central bank announced in July that it had sold 167 tonnes of gold in the preceding six months, reducing its holding to 80 tonnes. Official reserve assets, in Australian dollars:
